tip: Front an adverb like däremot and the verb moves ahead of the subject: däremot gillar jag, not däremot jag gillar.
Oroa sig (to worry) is reflexive; the pronoun tracks the subject, so with du you say oroa dig, with jag oroa mig.
The -s on ses makes it reciprocal: see each other. The same trick gives träffas (meet) and hörs (talk soon).
Skulle plus a bare verb like göra expresses would, a hypothetical: han skulle göra det, not something he actually did.
Varken ... eller is the fixed pair for neither ... nor: varken han eller hon. Use eller here, never och.
Istället för att takes an infinitive: istället för att vänta = instead of waiting, not instead of to wait.
For hypotheticals Swedish uses the past tense: om jag var du means if I were you, literally if I was you.
Inte bara ... utan också frames not only ... but also: inte bara rapporten utan också presentationen.
